title: Seniorin um Bankkarte betrogen – Wer erkennt die Tatverdächtigen?

extraction.summaryEn: A 66-year-old woman was tricked by a phone caller posing as a bank employee into handing over her bank card and PIN; a man collected the card at her flat and cash was withdrawn at a bank branch. Police are seeking two unknown suspects via CCTV images.
